dialect.detail: Likely GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) test suite targeting UNIX; SOURCE-COMPUTER/OBJECT-COMPUTER set to UNIX, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, no COMP-3, no CICS/SQL, filename prefix TST suggests test harness

purpose.domain_detail: COBOL compiler/runtime behavior test: tests numeric PIC 9 and PIC S9 field comparison semantics under various initialization methods (no init, MOVE SPACES, MOVE X, INITIALIZE) across multiple variable configurations (plain, REDEFINES, group, group REDEFINES)
purpose.summary: This program is a test suite that systematically checks how PIC 9 and PIC S9 numeric fields compare against 0, ZEROES, '0000', SPACES, and blanks under different initialization scenarios. It covers 8 variable configurations including plain fields, REDEFINES, and group items. Results are displayed in a tabular format showing equality outcomes and raw dump values.

notable_features: REDEFINES used extensively for type-punning tests
Tabular display output with FILLER headers
No PERFORM, no CALL, no GOTO — flat inline procedure
Tests ZEROES vs ZEROS (both figurative constants)
INITIALIZE statement tested as initialization method
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 2461 lines covering 8 variable cases. The repetitive structure is intentional for exhaustive comparison testing. Author 'VDE', date 11/07/08. The TST prefix and MFC in the name may indicate a Micro Focus Compatibility test suite, though UNIX computer names and no MF-specific syntax suggest GnuCOBOL targeting.
